title: Medical Insurance for Gig Economy Workers
what_it_is: Medical Insurance for Gig Economy Workers

sections.label: Support for self-employed persons
sections.summary: The Government set up a Tripartite Workgroup on SEPs in 2017 and has implemented its recommendations since March 2018, including MediShield Life coverage and PML insurance.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: In 2017, the Government set up a Tripartite Workgroup on self-employed persons (SEPs).

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: Since March 2018, we have been implementing the Workgroup's recommendations to address SEPs' challenges.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: Today, all SEPs are already covered under MediShield Life against large hospital bills.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: To mitigate this, we worked with insurers to make available Prolonged Medical Leave (PML) insurance products.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: Today, major intermediaries, like Grab and Gojek, provide PML insurance coverage at no additional cost to their regular drivers.

sections.label: Contribute-as-you-Earn pilot
sections.summary: Government agencies lead the Contribute-as-you-Earn pilot, where SEPs contribute to MediSave as they receive payment for their services.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: In addition, Government agencies have taken the lead to implement the "Contribute-as-you-Earn" (CAYE) pilot, where SEPs contribute to their MediSave accounts as they receive payment for their services.

sections.label: Workfare Income Supplement for SEPs
sections.summary: Over 40,000 SEPs receive WIS yearly, and WIS for SEPs was enhanced by raising the income ceiling to $2,300 and maximum payouts to $2,667.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: Each year, more than 40,000 SEPs receive WIS.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: We have recently enhanced WIS for SEPs by increasing the qualifying income ceiling from $2,000 to $2,300, and the maximum annual payouts from $2,400 to $2,667.
